entries.title: Nehemiah 6:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and [that] there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

words.text: ¶Now it came to pass, when Sanballat

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:2
segments: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in [some one of] the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:3
segments: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I [am] doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:4
segments: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:5
segments: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:6
segments: Wherein [was] written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith [it, that] thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words. {Gashmu: also called, Geshem}

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:7
segments: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, [There is] a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

words.text: : and now shall it be reported
now therefore, and let us take counsel

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:8
segments: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

words.text: them out of thine own heart

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:9
segments: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, [O God], strengthen my hands.

words.text: For they all made us afraid

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:10
segments: ¶Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who [was] shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:11
segments: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who [is there], that, [being] as I [am], would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:12
segments: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:13
segments: Therefore [was] he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and [that] they might have [matter] for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:14
segments: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

words.text: , that would have put me in fear

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:15
segments: ¶So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth [day] of [the month] Elul, in fifty and two days.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:16
segments: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard [thereof], and all the heathen that [were] about us saw [these things], they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

words.text: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:17
segments: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and [the letters] of Tobiah came unto them. {sent...: Heb. multiplied their letters passing to Tobiah}

words.text: unto them. {sent...: Heb. multiplied their letters passing to Tobiah}

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:18
segments: For [there were] many in Judah sworn unto him, because he [was] the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

words.text: unto him, because he [was] the son in law

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:19
segments: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. [And] Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear. {words: or, matters}
